clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Christoph Jeffcoat is trying to prove the Forsaken can cook with care. He needs snapjaw meat from Hillsbrad's waterways and the shores of Lordamere Lake for his turtle bisque.

Many believe the Forsaken have left the comforts of life behind, including fine cooking. Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill rejects that belief. He boasts that his rich turtle bisque could tempt souls back from beyond the grave. Through careful cooking, he means to show that undead hands can still make a warming dish in a land marked by plague and war.

Jeffcoat once gathered ingredients himself from Hillsbrad's waterways and Lordamere Lake's eastern shores in neighboring Alterac. Duties in Tarren Mill and nearby Alliance forces keep him from hunting. He depends on passing Horde cooks to hunt snapjaws, bring back their meat, and keep the recipe alive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...
Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.
If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck finding the ingredients? I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...

clips.title: Completion
paras: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... If you care about that kind of thing.
